last.verdict: Great quarter, but a warning that daily users could drop sharply next quarter.

reasons.label: Users could fall sharply
reasons.text: Reddit said daily users could fall by a low-double-digit percentage in Q4 from 130 million.

reasons.label: Google traffic keeps shrinking
reasons.text: Search referrals fell by more than 1 million a week in October, after a decline that sped up late in Q3.

reasons.label: U.S. users shrinking
reasons.text: U.S. daily users fell 2% from a year earlier; growth came from outside the U.S.

story: Reddit's growth is slowing, from 61% last quarter to 53% now, but profits keep climbing. The recurring worry is falling Google search traffic and weak U.S. user growth. The stock fell 21% after the last report and is down again.

history.verdict: Strong quarter, but weaker user and search-traffic signs sent investors selling hard.

reasons.label: Search traffic wobbling
reasons.text: CEO called Google search referrals "choppy," more volatile late in the quarter; no new licensing deals.

reasons.label: U.S. users slipped
reasons.text: U.S. daily users reportedly dipped from the prior quarter; only 6% year-over-year growth.

reasons.label: Sky-high expectations
reasons.text: Revenue grew 61% to $805M, but the stock had run up and priced in more.
